title.zh: 规划（土地租赁与处置）（合并）命令
title.en: Planning (Leases and Disposal of Land) (Consolidation) Order

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Planning (Leases and Disposal of Land) (Consolidation) Order.

heading.en: Additional leases not regarded as disposal of land

text.en:
2. Any lease granted on or after —
(a)7th November 2003 for a term not exceeding an aggregate of 21 years of
(i)any unit in any development described in Part I of the Third Schedule to the Act; or
(ii)any building or part thereof comprised in a development described in Part II of the Third Schedule to the Act;
[S 783/2022 wef 03/10/2022]
[S 519/2003 — 7.11.2003]
(b)5th July 2004 for a term not exceeding an aggregate of 21 years of any building or part thereof comprised in such development which is or is to be lawfully used as a business park or science park; or
[S 408/2004 — 5.7.2004]
[S 783/2022 wef 03/10/2022]
(c)3 October 2022 for a term not exceeding an aggregate of 35 years, of any unit in a building or part thereof where written permission has been granted for the development of the building or part for use as an assisted living facility,
[S 783/2022 wef 03/10/2022]
shall be added to the list of leases in section 4(2) of the Act which shall not be regarded as a disposal of land.
